_comment: Prepared, not run (ADR 0005 rule 5; issue #12's own acceptance: 'If no budget is approved, prepare the reviewable run manifest and leave execution incomplete'). Every number under cost_estimate is computed by tests/test_matched_pilot.py from skillc/cost_estimate.py, not hand-typed - the SAME estimator #26 uses, not a second one (orchestrator instruction, msg 1410). Runtime implementation is deliberately out of scope here, per #12's own text: 'Keep runtime implementation out of the planning PR.'

model.name: gpt-5.1-codex
model.note: assumed default model behind the pinned Codex CLI as of 2026-09-26; not independently confirmed against a live 'codex --version'/config dump, since no live run exists yet

predeclared_experiment_record.image_digest_note: no image has been built for this pilot - #77/#85's Docker backend implementation exists, but building and running it is the operator's live run, not this planning PR. This is a named refusal to invent one, not a placeholder shaped like a real digest (orchestrator instruction, msg 1410).

goal_population.note: the SAME already-qualified task and grader #26's selection probe reuses (#5) - #12 measures task-outcome benefit and completion time, not selection behavior, so no case-format prompt addendum is used here

treatment_vs_baseline.treatment: the whole CPP pack (74 skills) installed, per subject.json's select: "all"
treatment_vs_baseline.baseline: an identical disposable home with no skill installed - the SAME matched-minimal-baseline shape skillc/materialize.py already uses

repeat_schedule.rationale: a bounded first pilot: enough repeats per arm (3) to see attempt-to-attempt variance without ballooning cost or scope; not extended further until this pilot's own evidence justifies it (#12's own text: this is the FIRST bounded matched pilot, not a full-power study)

predeclared_experiment_record.arm_order: treatment then baseline, per repeat, matching skillc/materialize.py's existing arm ordering

time_caps.note: not yet enforced by any committed control in this PR - skillc/backend.py's Limits is where this would be wired once a live run drives it

predeclared_experiment_record.monetary_ceiling_source: operator ruling relayed 2026-09-26 (msg 1401/1402, carried into #12 per msg 1410): the $5 whole-run ceiling applies here too, enforced in code by skillc.cost_estimate.authorize, refused regardless of any approved budget above it

clarification_and_approval_behavior.clarification: no interactive clarification is available during a trial - attempts run non-interactively (codex exec / an equivalent non-interactive invocation, matching skillc/trial_bootstrap.py's own 'never auto-answer' rule from #78). If the agent's own output poses a clarifying question instead of proceeding, that attempt's pilot-report entry declares it explicitly under 'uncertainty' and counts it in 'interventions' - it is never auto-answered from outside the attempt.
clarification_and_approval_behavior.approval: the SAME gate #26 uses: skillc.cost_estimate.authorize() refuses to authorize execution without an approved budget at or above the estimate, and separately refuses any estimate over the $5 ceiling regardless of a larger approved budget. No paid call may start without both.

price.name: gpt-5.1-codex
price.source: pricepertoken.com, 2026-09-26 (third-party aggregator, not independently confirmed against OpenAI's own page) - the SAME price #26 uses

assumptions.basis: no attempt has ever run against this subject; these are placeholder assumptions (system prompt + CPP skill listing + goal.md for input, agent reasoning/tool calls/patch for output), not measurements. The first live attempt should replace them with observed values. This assumption reads like a single turn and is weak in a specific, known direction: a multi-turn agentic Codex session re-sends its context (including the 74-skill listing) every turn, so real input could be 10-20x higher. Sensitivity, at these prices, same 6 attempts: 500,000 input tokens/attempt -> $4.05 total (still under the $5 ceiling); 1,000,000 input tokens/attempt -> $7.80 total (OVER the $5 ceiling - skillc.cost_estimate.authorize would refuse it before any cache discount is applied).
